senses.gloss:
तोक n. (-कं) A child, a son or daughter, male or female offspring. E.
तु a Sautra root, to increase, affix क, deriv. irr. also तोकक.

तोक्म m. (-क्मः)
 1. Green or unripe barley.
 2. Green, (the colour.)
 n.
(-क्मं)
 1. The wax of the ear.
 2. A cloud.
 E. तक् to deride, म affix,
and ओ substituted for the radical vowel; it is also written तोक्य.
